name: Read
description: Read a file from the local filesystem.

path.description: Path to the file to read

name: Write
description: Write a file to the local filesystem.

path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

name: Edit
description: Edit a file by replacing an exact string match with a new string.

path.description: Path to the file to edit

old_string.description: The exact text to find and replace

name: Bash
description: Execute a bash command. Returns stdout and stderr.

name: Glob
description: Fast file pattern matching tool that works with any codebase size.

path.description: Optional directory to search from. Defaults to .

name: Grep
description: A powerful search tool built on ripgrep.

pattern.description: Text or regex pattern to search for

path.description: Optional file or directory to search. Defaults to .

glob.description: Optional file glob filter, for example *.sh

name: TodoWrite
description: Create and manage a structured task list for the current coding session. Use proactively for complex multi-step implementation, debugging, refactoring, review, or multi-file work. Do not use for trivial single-step or purely informational requests.

todos.description: The full updated todo list for the current session. Send the complete list each time, not a partial diff.

content.description: A short, concrete, actionable task description.

status.description: Task status: pending, in_progress, or completed. Prefer exactly one in_progress item while actively working.
